== Overview ==

LightOT is tracked as a top Open Tibia server from the public otservlist players-online ranking under the listing title "PVP-E RPG CUSTOM". This page preserves the searchable server name, host, client/version signals, players-online snapshot, uptime, EXP rate, PvP type, and source attribution so players can compare it while the live Supabase sync and owner-claimed profile continue to enrich the record.
